verdict.rationale: Motion documents daily meeting caps ('Set daily limits and watch Motion enforce them automatically... calendar becomes unbookable') and a bookable link/embed for prospects, which covers two elements of the story (booking caps, shareable booking window). However there is no evidence of pre/post-meeting buffers, minimum notice periods, or custom date-range availability windows for booking links. missing for 10: buffer time before/after meetings, minimum notice settings, date-range window configuration, independent/hands-on confirmation of these booking-link protections.
